svg.text: GPS deployer: where to put it

g.text: facing: type it in from F3

svg.text: open sky above: it flies straight up
and digs anything in the way
four GPS hosts at the top
one raised so they're not in one plane
• It asks for the turtle's X, Y, Z and facing (F3): there's no GPS yet to find them.
• Satellites (gps-deploy satellite) need the extra hull, solar, bar, slab, light and rod blocks listed in the README.
